name: NGC 5486, SN 2004cm field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5486, a Magellanic-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2004cmhost-hubble
story: NGC 5486 was home to SN 2004cm, a faint, nickel-poor Type II-plateau supernova found by the SDSS Collaboration. Hubble looks back at the galaxy where that dim stellar explosion took place.

claims.text: SN 2004cm is a low-luminosity, nickel-poor Type II-plateau supernova
SN 2004cm was a Type II supernova discovered by the SDSS Collaboration
The Hubble pointing matches the position of SN 2004cm
